Little Rae Sloane, manning an entire Super Star Destroyer all by herself. Our last, isn't it?|Valco Pandion, to Rae Sloane|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
The '''''Ravager''''' was an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] of the [[Imperial Navy]]. It was also one of the largest and most powerful [[Imperial Military|military]] [[warship]]s ever constructed by the [[Galactic Empire]]. By the [[time]] of the [[Rebellion on Akiva]], the ''Ravager'' was known to be the last remaining [[Super Star Destroyer]] in the Imperial [[Navy]], commanded by [[Fleet Admiral]]—and later [[Counselor to the Empire]]—[[Gallius Rax]], who was presumed [[Death|dead]] by the majority of the remaining Imperials in the [[Standard month|months]] following the [[Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
One of the largest and most powerful [[Starship|vessels]] ever created for the [[Galactic Empire]], the ''Ravager'' was 19,000 [[meter]]s long, and boasted more than 5,000 [[turbolaser]]s and [[ion cannon]]s. Like other [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]], the center of its arrowhead-shaped [[hull]] was covered by a [[city]]-like superstructure, while the underside hosted most of the engineering systems. The aft end of the ''Ravager'' was marked by a trapezoid [[Bridge (starship)|command tower]] crowned by two geodesic communication and [[Deflector shield|deflection]] domes. At the bottom end of the hull were 13 [[engine]] thrusters responsible for its movement.<ref name="SWE" />

[[Gallius Rax]]'s office on the ''Ravager'' featured an aquarium full of diaphanous water [[Species|creatures]], weapons, an ornate tapestry and a [[Holomap|holo-map]] of [[the galaxy]]. The ''Ravager'' also had a private upper garden, which Rax used for recreational purposes.<ref name="Life Debt" />

==History==
===Rax's flagship===
[[File:Ravager-SSD-BattleOfJakkuInsurgencyRising2.jpg|thumb|left|280px|The Super Star Destroyer ''Ravager'' after the Battle of Endor]]
Constructed by [[Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="Ultimate SW" /> the ''Ravager'' served as the [[flagship]] of Gallius Rax.<ref name="Aftermath" /> Prior to the [[Battle of Endor]], Rax and the ''Ravager'' were sent by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] to hide in the [[Vulpinus Nebula]] until the events of a [[shatterpoint]] felt by Palpatine were resolved.<ref name="Empire's End" /> In the [[Standard month|months]] following the pivotal battle that saw the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] destroy the Galactic Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] and the ''[[Executor]]'', flagship of [[Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Vader's]] [[Death Squadron]],<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> it eventually became the last known [[Super Star Destroyer]] in Imperial possession. Due to this, the ''Ravager'' became the most prized ship in the [[Imperial Navy]], sought by self-appointed [[Grand Moff]] [[Valco Pandion]]. Aware of its power, Pandion attended the [[Akiva Summit|Imperial meeting]] on [[Akiva]] to seize control of the ''Ravager'', rumored to be in possession of [[Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]], [[commander]] of the [[Vigilance (Imperial-class)|''Vigilance'']]. Secretly an envoy of Rax, Sloane returned to the bridge of the ''Ravager'', then located near the Vulpinus [[Nebula]], to report the failed negotiations to him after the [[Rebellion on Akiva]].<ref name="Aftermath" />

In [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Life Debt date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> the ''Ravager'' continued to serve as the headquarters of the now-[[Grand Admiral]] Sloane, who commanded [[Imperial Military|Imperial]] forces in the Vulpinus Nebula. In reality, Sloane served as a front for [[Fleet Admiral]] Rax, who posed as her [[Advisor|adviser]]. Under Rax's orders, Sloane convened the [[Shadow Council]] to rebuild the Empire. Rax used the ''Ravager'' to initiate the [[Attack on Chandrila|attack]] on [[Chandrila]]. Following Sloane's disappearance on Chandrila, now-[[Counselor to the Empire]] Rax used the ship to command the Imperial [[fleet]] scattered across the [[galaxy]].<ref name="Life Debt" />

===Battle of Jakku===
{{Quote|No. My ship.|Rae Sloane upon seeing the ''Ravager'' taking damage during the the Battle of Jakku|<ref name="Empire's End" />}}
[[File:AmityBattleofJakku.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Ravager'' engages in combat with the ''Amity'']]
Months later, the ''Ravager'' served as the flagship of the Empire, which had relocated to [[Jakku]]. During the [[Battle of Jakku]], the ''Ravager'' acted as the Imperial [[command ship]] and was commanded by Grand Moff [[Randd]]. Randd's tacticians devised a tactic of having the other [[Star Destroyer]]s encircle the ''Ravager'' to form a defensive perimeter. Throughout the battle, the [[Star]] Destroyers would open formation to allow the ''Ravager'' to bombard the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]]. [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force|forces]] under Fleet Admiral [[Gial Ackbar|Ackbar]] succeeded in tightening the Imperial formations but were unable to break through.<ref name="Empire's End" />

Randd's strategy unraveled when [[Captain]] [[Groff]] of the Star Destroyer ''[[Punishment]]'' rammed into the [[Starhawk-class battleship|''Starhawk''-class battleship]] ''[[Amity]]'', which created a gap in the Imperial lines and allowed [[Commodore]] [[Kyrsta Agate]] to position her Starhawk ''[[Concord]]'' in the gap and bombard the ''Ravager''. Despite being crippled by the ''Ravager''{{'s}} [[cannon]]s, Agate managed to use her ship's powerful [[tractor beam projector]] to drag the Super Star Destroyer into Jakku's [[atmosphere]]. New Republic starships and fighters also pummeled the ''Ravager''{{'s}} engines, disabling the ship. Amidst the chaos, Randd fled into an [[escape pod]].<ref name="Empire's End" />

[[File:SSD_Ravager_wreck_TFA.jpg|left|220x220px|thumb|The ''Ravager's'' resting place in the Graveyard of Giants]]
After the ''Concord''{{'s}} tractor beam failed, the ''Ravager''{{'s}} thrusters attempted to stabilize, but overcompensated, inverting the Empire's final Super Star Destroyer. The ''Ravager'' crashed in an area that became known as the [[Starship Graveyard|Graveyard of Giants]], crushing an [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT]] [[walker]] and several [[starfighter]]s in the process. The destruction of the ''Ravager'' turned the tide of the battle in the New Republic's favor. Following the Battle of Jakku, the Empire capitulated and signed the [[Galactic Concordance]] with the New Republic.<ref name="Empire's End" />

===Legacy===
After it crashed, its rusting halls gained a sinister reputation among scavengers.<ref name="CVDNE">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> In [[34 ABY]], twenty-nine [[Standard year|years]] after its crash, [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] [[pilot]]ed the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' through the wreckage of the ''Ravager'' while evading a [[First Order]] [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighter]] while [[Escape from Jakku|escaping]], with [[Finn]] and [[BB-8]], from Jakku.<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Ravager'' first appeared in the [[2015]] [[canon]] novel [[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']].<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref> In the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]'', the vessel was seen crashing during the beginning of matches on the Graveyard of Giants map. The ''Ravager's'' wreckage then appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]''</ref>
